info.name: Consents Account On File Account Controls (New) Account Controls (New) Open Banking Beneficiaries API

params.name: AccountId
params.description: The Lean account identifier uniquely identifying the account within Lean.

params.name: EntityId
params.description: The entity_id of the connected customer.

params.name: CustomerId
params.description: The customer_id of the connected customer.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page you're requesting - returns page 0 of a response if not specified.

params.name: Size
params.description: The number of objects you want to return as a page size.

items.docs:
Retrieves the beneficiaries for a bank account linked by a user via LinkSDK for the KSA Open Banking (SAMA) ecosystem.
Each beneficiary object contains the beneficiary type, account holder name, creditor agent, and creditor account details.
Requires ReadBeneficiariesBasic or ReadBeneficiariesDetail consent permission.
